films.title: Bang, Boom, Bang
films.overview: Bank robber Kalle Grabowski escapes from prison while his unemployed smalltime crook buddy is sitting around doing nothing after he just lost all their money. A fast paced comedy from German director Peter Thorwarth.

films.title: If It Don't Fit, Use a Bigger Hammer
films.overview: Frustrated with their lazy new intern, a trio of offbeat builders decide to teach him a lesson with a series of escalating pranks.

films.title: Not My Day
films.overview: When Banker Till (Axel Stein) is kidnapped during a bank robbery, he has the time of his life...

films.title: Blood & Gold
films.overview: At the end of World War II, a German soldier is looking for his daughter while an SS troop is looking for a Jewish treasure.

films.title: Blood Red Sky
films.overview: A woman with a mysterious illness is forced into action when a group of terrorists attempt to hijack a transatlantic overnight flight. In order to protect her son she will have to reveal a dark secret, and unleash the inner monster she has fought to hide.
